juniorWebDeveloper: As a Junior Web Developer, I'm very excited to start my journey in this fantastic world of web development.
paragraph1: I am a passionate full-stack web developer experienced in React, JavaScript, TypeScript, and other modern frameworks.
paragraph2: I am dedicated to crafting smooth and interactive user experiences. In my free time, I love to explore new technologies and work on personal projects that challenge me to improve my skills.
paragraph3: Throughout my journey I have learned to use backend technologies such as ASP.NET with C#, Next.js and NestJS, expanding my expertise to relational databases (SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis).
paragraph4: I am particularly passionate about frontend development because of the immediate results it delivers and the beauty of graphic details: I use Tailwind CSS and Bootstrap to build modern, responsive interfaces. I am also fascinated by SEO and performance optimization.
paragraph5: Backend development is equally exciting: building RESTful APIs, managing databases, integrating Redis for caching, and orchestrating microservices. I also work with Linux VPS infrastructure, setting up Cloudflare tunnels, domain management, SSL certificates, and server permissions to deploy applications securely and scalably in production.
gestionaleDesc: Restofull.it is my web management system for restaurants, built with Next.js, NestJS, MongoDB, and Redis. It provides full management of orders, tables, menus, and reservations. Deployed on a Linux VPS with Cloudflare tunnels for secure and high-performance access.
